buildLog.narration: Nearing the top of our impressive skyscraper! Adding the final floors before we crown it with a stunning rooftop!
Finishing our magnificent skyscraper with office interiors and lighting! Then welcoming our first office workers to this impressive tower!
Creating a beautiful central park for our citizens to relax! Adding more trees, benches, and colorful flower gardens.
Completing our beautiful central park with more seating and lighting! Then expanding our city with a productive farm district.
Expanding our farm with more crops and building a proper barn! Soon we'll have livestock too for a complete farming operation.
Building up our sturdy farm barn with strong wooden walls! Then we'll add animal pens for cows, pigs, and chickens.
Completing our animal pens and welcoming livestock to the farm! Adding cows, pigs, and chickens to make this a thriving agricultural center.
Adding final touches to our farm and welcoming a farmer! Then expanding our city with a cozy restaurant district for dining and entertainment.
Building up our cozy tavern walls and adding windows! Soon our citizens will have a perfect place to gather and socialize.
Adding the tavern roof and then furnishing this cozy establishment with tables, a bar, and all the comforts for our citizens to enjoy!
Finishing our tavern with a proper bar, cozy seating, and warm lighting! Then welcoming our first patrons to this lively gathering place.
Expanding south with our first residential district! Laying down roads and building cozy homes for our growing population.
Building up our first cozy cottage with stone walls and charming details! This will be a perfect home for our residents.
Adding cozy interior furnishings to our cottage and then building another home across the street! Our residential district is coming to life.
Completing the walls of our second cottage with warm spruce wood! This charming home will perfectly complement our growing residential street.
Finishing our second cottage with cozy interior furnishings! Then connecting our growing districts with beautiful infrastructure.
Completing our southern road extension with sidewalks and street lights! Then building a beautiful bridge to connect our expanding districts.
Building up our elegant stone bridge with decorative railings! This will beautifully connect our residential districts and add charm to our city.
Adding final touches to our beautiful stone bridge! Then expanding our city with a new industrial district featuring workshops and storage facilities.
Building up our industrial workshop with sturdy deepslate walls! Soon our craftsmen will have a proper place to work and create goods for the city.
